create_BoltJobSummary: create a BoltJobSummary dataclass to track job name, instance IDs, success status, and bolt metrics
create_BoltMetric: create a BoltMetric dataclass to record a metric type, value, optional stage, and optional role
use_BoltMetricType_enum: use the BoltMetricType enum to define metric types like JOB_QUEUE_TIME, JOB_RUN_TIME, and STAGE_TOTAL_RUNTIME
filter_BoltJobSummary_job_metrics: filter BoltJobSummary bolt_metrics to return only job-level metrics where stage is None
filter_BoltJobSummary_stage_metrics: filter BoltJobSummary bolt_metrics to return only stage-level metrics or query by specific stage or role
